meta.title: Job journal
meta.description: Ask DSH about synced job applications, greeting receipts and timeouts, or look up a single trace. The current profile receives events at 127.0.0.1:18761. For first-time pairing, open data/dsh-job-journal/credentials.json in the active DSH profile and enter its code in the userscript. Previously synced events remain available after the browser closes.
